title: Refactor Hardcoded Database Connections
problem_statement: The application uses hardcoded database connection strings, which are insecure and inflexible.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential data breaches and lack of flexibility in changing database configurations.
suggested_approach: Abstract the database connection into a configuration file and use environment variables for sensitive information.
success_criteria: Database connections are configurable without code changes.
Sensitive information is not stored in source code.
